contrary_evidence: PMI readings are diffusion indices, not GDP growth rates.
The US high-yield OAS is not a global credit-stress measure.
IIF portfolio flows are monthly estimates, not daily November flows.
Crude supply recovery does not establish that refined-product availability has normalized.
Focus medians for 2026 are distinct from the Ministry of Finance 2027 parameter grid.
Conflict claims remain attributed to the relevant actors and reporting institutions.
limitations: The BCB PTAX reference is a dynamic institutional landing page rather than a date-filtered historical endpoint.
The BCB Focus report is dated 19 November; the B3 story was published 23 November.
The RBA date may refer to effectiveness, but the report does not label the date type.
Registry reconciliation remains a publisher prerequisite.
The production deployment was not confirmed because Cloudflare credentials were missing.
